clue.text: Flier in a flap, not knowing the words to sing?

definitions.text: Flier in a flap, not knowing the words to sing?

parts.words: Flier in a flap, not knowing the words to sing?
parts.note: a tiny ... whose wings beat so fast they buzz, named after the sound you make when you carry a tune without its lyrics

explanation.surface: A flustered bird has forgotten the lyrics of its song.
explanation.definitionFit: This tiny American bird is named for the drone of its rapidly beating wings, the same sound a singer makes without words.

clue.text: The plea made for a feature of flamenco dancing

indicators.note: the letters of the words are made into something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone pleads on behalf of an element of Spanish dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' signals the rearrangement of THE PLEA.
explanation.definitionFit: A heeltap is the layer of a shoe heel, and stamping heelwork is a hallmark of the Spanish dance.

clue.text: Handy little stores of information

parts.note: reads like a description of pocket reference books, but describes small desktop machines that hold data

explanation.definitionFit: Small personal computers are compact, convenient devices that store data.

clue.text: Doctrines contained in one's writing

parts.note: one's is I'S, I being the Roman numeral for one
MS is the abbreviation for manuscript, a piece of writing

explanation.surface: A creed is set out in a person's own handwriting.
explanation.definitionFit: Isms are distinctive beliefs or ideologies, the suffix used as a noun.

clue.text: Stick around a Greek island for a source of energy

indicators.note: the adhesive word is placed around the island, holding it inside

parts.note: glue is something that sticks
Cos (Kos) is a Greek island in the Dodecanese

explanation.surface: Something adhesive surrounds a holiday isle and fuels you.
explanation.definitionFit: This simple sugar is the body's main fuel, broken down by cells to release energy.

clue.text: See 1
Girl game the thestart

parts.note: bridge is a card game

indicators.note: the start of the word the gives only its first letter

explanation.surface: A girl's game is under way at the beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: Bridget is a female forename, so it stands for a girl.

clue.text: Bring up at thestern

definitions.meaning: to bring up children is to raise them
the stern is the back part of a ship

explanation.definitionFit: Raising a family is rearing it, and the stern is the hindmost part of a vessel.

clue.text: Happy in substance

definitions.meaning: the material or meaning contained in something

explanation.definitionFit: Content as an adjective means satisfied; as a noun it means the matter or meaning held within something.

clue.text: It's a proper map I find put to a wrong use

definitions.text: It's a proper map I find put to a wrong use

indicators.note: letters that are misused are put to a different purpose, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A perfectly good map has been used for the wrong purpose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put to a wrong use' both defines the answer and tells you to rearrange IT'S A PROPER MAP I.
explanation.definitionFit: To misappropriate is to divert something for an improper purpose, especially funds.

clue.text: It gives cut in income, leaving Max nothing but put out

definitions.text: It gives cut in income, leaving Max nothing but put out

indicators.note: something put out is disturbed, so these letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A man called Max has had his pay docked and is left with nothing but annoyance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put out' rearranges CUT IN INCOME and MAX with O; the whole clue also describes being expelled from the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Excommunication expels a person from the church, putting them out of the community.

clue.text: Understood to be all right

parts.note: taken as written
OK means all right

explanation.surface: Someone has grasped that things are fine.
explanation.definitionFit: To take something a certain way is to interpret it, so 'took' can mean grasped or interpreted.

clue.text: Ought to be tenacious; and is

indicators.note: the letters are to be, that is to become, a different word, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone should be determined, and indeed is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be' signals that OUGHT becomes another word; 'and is' adds that the result itself means tenacious.
explanation.definitionFit: Tough means resilient and hard to wear down, like something tenacious.

clue.text: Tea served at the end of a chess game?

definitions.meaning: a caffeinated South American infusion drunk from a gourd

definitions.text: the end of a chess game?
definitions.meaning: checkmate finishes a game of chess

explanation.surface: A cuppa is brought out as a chess match finishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Maté is a caffeinated South American infusion, and checkmate ends a chess game.

clue.text: Expensive guest accommodation in silhouette form

indicators.note: to form something is to shape it anew, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Costly lodgings take the shape of an outline.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of connected rooms in an inn is the priciest lodging a guest can book.

clue.text: See 13
Suggest writing about an Italian flower

indicators.note: the written word goes about the river, wrapping round it

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language
a flower is something that flows, a river; the Po is Italy's longest river

explanation.surface: Someone recommends writing about a bloom from Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' means a river here, something that flows, not a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: To propose is to put forward an idea for consideration.

clue.text: Trunk call in the wind

definitions.meaning: an elephant's loud cry, made through its trunk
a brass instrument played in the wind section of an orchestra

explanation.definitionFit: Elephants are said to trumpet when they bellow, and the brass trumpet is blown in an orchestra's wind section.

clue.text: Darlings of modern music makers?

parts.note: a term of endearment for beloved people, read as the favourites of pop musicians

explanation.definitionFit: Poppet is a British term of endearment, so poppets are sweethearts; split, it suggests pets of pop.

clue.text: Terribly affected over a cut in pay

indicators.note: the article and the cut go in the word pay, which wraps round them

parts.note: a nick is a small cut

explanation.surface: Someone is badly upset by a reduction in their wages.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone panicky is gripped by sudden fear, badly shaken.

clue.text: Said to be a rebuff albeit cunning

indicators.note: signals that the word for a rebuff is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: a slight is a snub or rebuff

explanation.surface: A snub is described as rather crafty.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight means dexterous trickery, as in sleight of hand, so it is a kind of craftiness.

clue.text: Looping the loop is a danger to road-users

indicators.note: letters looping round are twisted out of order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An aerobatic stunt is called hazardous for motorists.
explanation.definitionFit: A pit in a road surface can damage vehicles and cause accidents.

clue.text: Main way to describe 22

definitions.meaning: the main is an old word for the open sea or ocean
an adjective meaning calm and tranquil, describing the answer to 22 across

explanation.definitionFit: The Pacific is the largest ocean, and pacific means peaceable, a word for concord.

clue.text: Males deed upset being corrected

indicators.note: the males go in the rearranged deed
the letters of deed are knocked over into a new order

parts.note: men are males

explanation.surface: Men are truly annoyed at being put right.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'indeed' must be read as two words, 'in deed', for the container to work.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend a text is to correct it, so emended means put right.

clue.text: Isn't a cardinal point, observe

parts.note: isn't, read as is not, gives the word not
E is east, one of the four cardinal points of the compass

explanation.surface: Someone is told to watch something that is not a compass direction.
explanation.definitionFit: To note something is to notice or take heed of it.

clue.text: Step outside Egypt's capital for concord

indicators.note: the stride goes outside the letter, holding it inside

parts.note: a pace is a single step

indicators.note: a capital is a head letter, so only the first letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: Someone strides around Cairo seeking harmony.
explanation.definitionFit: Peace is harmony and freedom from conflict, which is what concord means.

clue.text: Time to be sorry and adjust

parts.note: to rue is to regret or be sorry

explanation.surface: It is time to regret and make changes.
explanation.walkthrough: To true up a wheel or a frame is to adjust it so it is exactly straight.
explanation.definitionFit: Engineers true a wheel, making precise adjustments so it runs straight.

clue.text: Highly-strung bird

definitions.meaning: flown high on the end of a string
a bird of prey of the hawk family

explanation.definitionFit: A child's toy flown aloft on a line is literally strung high, and the red kite is a fork-tailed raptor.

clue.text: Source of quiet noise at the fo'c'slehead

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical instruction for quiet
a row is a loud noise or din

explanation.surface: Noise is heard from the front of the ship.
explanation.walkthrough: The fo'c'sle (forecastle) is the forward part of a ship, so its head is the very front.
explanation.definitionFit: The prow is the pointed front of a ship, the head of the forecastle.

clue.text: Such a conveyance seems putting the cart before the horse

definitions.text: Such a conveyance seems putting the cart before the horse

parts.words: Such a conveyance seems putting the cart before the horse
parts.note: a delivery term meaning the buyer pays on receipt, read as a horse-drawn vehicle sent ahead of its horse

explanation.definitionFit: A shipping term in which the receiver pays the delivery charge; literally it suggests a coach going first.

clue.text: Handled soft material

explanation.definitionFit: Felt is the past tense of feel, to touch, and also a pressed woollen cloth.

clue.text: He is found among a motley crowd of milk-producers

definitions.text: He is found among a motley crowd of milk-producers

indicators.note: the pronoun is placed in among the letters of the other piece
a motley assortment is jumbled, so the letters of crowd are mixed up

explanation.surface: A man stands amid a varied herd of dairy animals.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue describes the man who tends a herd of dairy cows, so it defines as well as builds the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowherd is a man who tends cattle, so he is out among the dairy herd.
